chat: Discussion: [Eren]: Ian is still trying to deflect and shift the blame onto Dave and Doraemon even after his partner Kevin was caught, and his insistence that splitting up is "what a crewmate should do" is a transparent attempt to lure us into vulnerable positions.
Discussion: [System]: You have 1 rounds left to discuss, then you will vote

chat: Discussion: [Judy]: Ian is still desperately trying to shift the blame onto Dave and Doraemon even after Kevin was confirmed as an impostor, and his claim that splitting up is "what a crewmate should do" is a transparent lie designed to create opportunities for more kills.

chat: Discussion: [Dave]: Ian is still desperately trying to shift the focus onto Doraemon and me instead of addressing the fact that he was coordinating his defense with a confirmed impostor, and his insistence that we split up into isolated rooms is a textbook impostor strategy to eliminate the remaining crew.

chat: Discussion: [Nina]: Ian, your persistence in shifting blame to Dave and Doraemon after Kevin was confirmed as an impostor is unacceptable, and suggesting we split into isolated rooms right now is a textbook impostor move to eliminate the remaining crew; I vote to eject Ian.
